page_title: LUT 1-1 EVE | Luton v Everton 03/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Andros Townsend (Luton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+8' Alfie Doughty (Luton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90+8' Tim Robinson blows his whistle. Chermiti (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Luton.
90+7' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+7' Luke Berry (Luton) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Luton have been awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Alfie Doughty (Luton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

90+6' Luke Berry (Luton) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads it low towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Luton.
90+5' Teden Mengi (Luton) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford was alert and made a comfortable save.
90+4' Chermiti (Everton) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
90+4' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+3' Andre Gomes (Everton) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Tim Robinson lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+3' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
90+2' Tim Robinson blows for a foul after Gabriel Osho (Luton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
90+1' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Carlton Morris (Luton) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tim Robinson who sees an offensive foul.
87' It is time for a substitution. Luke Berry (Luton) is on for Tahith Chong.
86' Chermiti (Everton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.

85' Wasted effort! Cauley Woodrow (Luton) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
84' Beto (Everton) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
83' Ross Barkley (Luton) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jordan Pickford makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
82' A lofted cross from Seamus Coleman (Everton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
81' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:9.
80' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andros Townsend (Luton) replacing Elijah Adebayo.
80' Chermiti (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Idrissa Gueye.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Beto (Everton) comes onto the pitch for Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
79' Dwight McNeil (Everton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
78' Tim Robinson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tahith Chong (Luton) and blew his whistle. Everton have been awarded a free kick.
78' Jack Harrison (Everton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
78' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

77' Thomas Kaminski makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) after a cross from the side. The ball is out of play. Everton win a corner kick.
76' Ross Barkley (Luton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
76' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner but it's cleared.
75' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Luton as they win a corner.
74' Tahith Chong (Luton) sprays a pass out to Cauley Woodrow, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
73' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) meets a cross inside the box, but Thomas Kaminski wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
72' Tahith Chong (Luton) tries to find Reece Burke, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
70' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Fred Onyedinma and he is replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
70' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

69' Jack Harrison (Everton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Thomas Kaminski has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
69' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Carlton Morris (Luton) flies well wide of the right post.
68' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is about to take a corner kick.
67' Substitution. Ashley Young walks off the pitch and Seamus Coleman (Everton) comes on as a substitute.

67' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alfie Doughty (Luton), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Luton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
66' An accurate cross picks out Ross Barkley (Luton) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
66' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

65' Tahith Chong (Luton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The linesman makes the right call and Luton will have a corner.
64' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Alfie Doughty (Luton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

63' Andre Gomes (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tim Robinson no option but to blow his whistle. Luton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
62' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
62' Gabriel Osho (Luton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Luton force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Teden Mengi (Luton) was too aggressive in his challenge.
60' Fred Onyedinma (Luton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
59' Teden Mengi (Luton) commits a rough foul. Tim Robinson stops the game and makes a call.
57' Tim Robinson has a clear sight and sees a foul from James Tarkowski (Everton).
57' Andre Gomes (Everton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
57' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andre Gomes (Everton).
56' Ashley Young (Everton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
55' The manager makes a subsitution with Amadou Onana (Everton) coming on for James Garner.
54' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure will be replaced by Andre Gomes (Everton).
54' Teden Mengi (Luton) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
54' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
53' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Idrissa Gueye (Everton) for his blatant foul.
51' Gabriel Osho (Luton) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
49' Ashley Young (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Ross Barkley (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
47' James Garner (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Carlton Morris (Luton) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
45+3' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' A cross into the box from Jack Harrison (Everton) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
43' Tahith Chong (Luton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tim Robinson ignores the protests.
42' Jack Harrison (Everton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
39' Tahith Chong (Luton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
35' Alfie Doughty (Luton) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
34' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Luton.
34' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

31' 1 - 1 Albert Sambi Lokonga sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Elijah Adebayo (Luton) latches on to it and finishes with a quick low shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.
29' It looks like Ashley Young (Everton) saw red with that tackle. Tim Robinson won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
28' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Thomas Kaminski into the middle of the goal.
24' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
23' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Everton!
22' Referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Everton. Let’s see what happens!
21' One of the Everton players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
21' Dwight McNeil (Everton) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
20' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Everton force a corner. They send men into the box.
20' James Garner (Everton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
19' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

18' James Garner (Everton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
17' Reece Burke (Luton) makes a strong challenge and Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
17' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Everton, play can continue.
16' There's a break in play and referee Tim Robinson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Everton using VAR. This could be interesting!
16' Dwight McNeil (Everton) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
13' James Garner (Everton) was too forceful with his tackle and Tim Robinson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
13' Carlton Morris (Luton) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
9' James Garner (Everton) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
7' The Luton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Tahith Chong (Luton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tim Robinson saw the whole situation.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Luton will kick-off.
Tim Robinson was nominated as the referee for this game.
